macros.name: glstopicAssignSubIndent
macros.doc: Used to set the indentation for sub-levels.

macros.name: glstopicColsEnv
macros.doc: Expands to the multicols environment name to use for topicmcols.

macros.name: glstopicDesc
macros.doc: Used to format the top-level description.

macros.name: glstopicGroupHeading
macros.doc: Used to format the top-level group headings, if required.

macros.name: glstopicInit
macros.doc: This hook is used at the start of the glossary.

macros.name: glstopicItem
macros.doc: Used to format top-level entries.

macros.name: glstopicLoc
macros.doc: Used to format the top-level location list.

macros.name: glstopicMarker
macros.doc: May be used to insert a bookmark etc if required.

macros.name: glstopicParIndent
macros.doc: Length register used for the top-level paragraph indent.

macros.name: glstopicPostSkip
macros.doc: Vertical space inserted after the description for a top-level entry.

macros.name: glstopicPreSkip
macros.doc: Vertical space inserted before a top-level entry.

macros.name: glstopicSubGroupHeading

arg.snippet: glstopicSubGroupHeading{${1:prev group level}}{${2:group level}}{${3:parent label}}{${4:group label}}

macros.doc: This formats the sub-group heading.

macros.name: glstopicSubIndent
macros.doc: This command is a length that’s used to calculate the hanging indentation for sub-entries.

macros.name: glstopicSubItemBox
macros.doc: Horizontal box used for child name if a widest name has been provided.

macros.name: glstopicSubItemSep
macros.doc: Horizontal separator used after child names.

macros.name: glstopicSubLoc
macros.doc: Formats the child location lists.

macros.name: glstopicSubNameFont
macros.doc: Font command to apply to the child entry name.

macros.name: glstopicSubPreLocSep
macros.doc: Separator before the child location lists.

macros.name: glstopicTitle
macros.doc: Used to format the name and (if provided) symbol for the top-level entry title.

macros.name: glstopicTitleFont
macros.doc: This uses a bold, large font by default.
